name: Unidentified gray wide-set-eyes species
description: This species was a sentient humanoid species distinguished by their gray skin and tall heads with wide-set eyes, some members of the species also sporting a series of small lobes extending from the back of their head, possibly consisting of hair or feathers. In 4 ABY, at least three members of this species, two adults and one child, boarded a transport headed for the planet Phorliss alongside the Human Mara Jade.
